finding: Skilled staff and production costs dominate Slovak firms' business concerns
bullets: Among the seven problems tested, skilled staff availability was the top concern for Slovak firms (n=239), scoring 6.64/10 — up 0.57 points from wave 38, exceeding the EA's 6.57/10, highlighting a growing talent gap.
Costs of production or labour ranked second at 6.62/10 (n=240), rising 0.43 points from wave 38, just below the EA score of 6.74/10, squeezing margins further.
Regulation scored 6.10/10 (n=236), easing marginally by 0.08 points from wave 38, yet remaining above the EA average of 5.87/10, still burdening compliance efforts.
chart_subtitle: Skilled staff scored 6.64/10 for Slovak firms in wave 39.
